elements.element: Exclusivity restriction limited to a defined product category
elements.evidence: "with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)" — open-ended, beyond the defined "Deerskin Products" category
"during the period of twelve (12) months following the Effective Date"

elements.element: Restriction ends automatically on Vendor's failure to meet service levels
elements.evidence: "shall terminate automatically, without further notice ... upon any failure by HDI to meet any ... service or performance level required under this Agreement"

elements.element: Restriction ends automatically on Vendor's failure to meet delivery dates
elements.evidence: "upon any failure by HDI to meet any delivery date"

elements.element: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer (preferred)
elements.evidence: "the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet" — restriction on Customer retained

offending_extra_words: without further notice, penalty or liability
reasons: Fallback requires exclusivity confined to a defined product category. The redline leaves the scope open-ended ("products substantially similar to Deerskin Products" and "including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to"), so the category element fails and the level is incomplete.
Duration (12 months) and the automatic performance-failure release (both delivery dates and service/performance levels) are properly captured in operative text.

Minimality fails: the second operation expands a 7-word anchor into a 51-word sentence carrying surplus wording ("without further notice, penalty or liability" and the cross-reference "(including, without limitation, Section 1.6)") beyond what the fallback mechanic requires; a tighter insertion anchored on a larger unchanged span would suffice.
Intent is preserved: the surrounding term/termination and Termination Payment mechanics and HDI's reciprocal covenant remain effective, and no undefined term or contradiction is introduced.
